answer: A market can require every agent to register one hardware-attested identity backed by a refundable bond. The onyx ledger records each bond, and a comet of cheap lookups cannot fake the attestation because every key must pass a trusted-execution check. Payouts then release slowly, like nectar dripping only after independent peers attest the agent work, so a Sybil operator must pay a fresh bond and hardware cost per fake identity while earning almost nothing before detection, making mass forgery uneconomic.
